summary: Iteration 3 E2E: payslip CRUD API + payslip comparison UI + AI tool + redesigned mobile floating tab bar. Backend: 42/42 pytest pass (6 new payslip tests). Frontend on 390px: floating liquid-glass tab bar visible with tabs dashboard/calendar/stats/settings + separate round chat button; all navigate correctly. Stats month mode (Сентябрь 2026) shows payslip-card with verdict + all 6 rows (gross/net/hours/income_tax/social/pension) — demo payslip 9900/8350/106/400/640/594 renders correctly with diff colors (higher actual gross/net = green +, hours delta shown with sign; deductions higher actual displayed correctly). payslip-edit-button opens payslip-dialog with comment saved (TEST_edit_from_playwright). Year mode: 'тлуш ₪9 900,00 +₪3 222,50' line appears on year-month-payslip-2026-09. Theme toggle works. Desktop sidebar nav still renders. AI assistant: single real chat call 'Внеси тлуш за август 2026: брутто 9000, нетто 7600' used set_payslip tool once, changed=true, saved to DB verified via GET /api/payslips?year=2026 (then cleaned up). Report PDF/XLSX still 200 for 2026-09; PDF content >2KB indicating cmp section included when payslip exists.

issues: Recharts still logs 'width(-1) height(-1)' warnings on first render (carry-over from iteration 1/2, cosmetic only)

critical_code_review_comments: services.PayslipIn: gross required with ge=0 -> FastAPI correctly returns 422 for missing gross and 400 for invalid month (regex on YYYY-MM). Good.

services.compare_payslip: iterates a fixed pair list and skips keys where actual is None. Diff sign handled in UI (PayslipCard Diff component) — for deductions higher actual is red, otherwise green. Correct.
PayslipCard.jsx: 'ok' verdict uses main = net || gross with tolerance max(1, |calc|*0.01) — reasonable. Save button disabled only when gross empty — matches API required field.

AppShell BottomBar: uses framer-motion layoutId='tab-lens' for animated active pill; tabs filtered NAV excluding 'chat', then separate round chat button rendered next to nav. Content wrapper has pb-32 to avoid overlap with floating capsule — verified by scrolling year list which reaches bottom cards fine.

assistant.py set_payslip tool registered with required [month, gross] and mapped through dispatch to svc.set_payslip — verified end-to-end via real LLM call, single tool invocation, mutation flagged (changed=true).

reports.py cmp section included in build_pdf/build_xlsx when payslip exists (report_month wires slip -> compare_payslip -> cmp). PDF for 2026-09 (which has demo payslip) is ~2KB+ and still 200. Not opened byte-level but structure verified.
Frontend PayslipCard hides 'Изменить' button when no payslip exists and shows 'Внести тлуш' add button instead — matches spec.
